{{Quote|They come, marching, believing themselves equal to the army of ancients that chained me. But I am not of their time. Their ancestors called me Soa, wrath and power, and knew fear. For I ruled a thousand worlds, and Korriban was my crown, Korriban my cradle and my testing ground. I have waited twenty thousand years, but I will wait no longer.|The Infernal One|<ref name="TOR:EV" />}}
'''Soa''', also known as '''The Infernal One''', was an extremely powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] who had been imprisoned in the [[Eternity Vault]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for nearly twenty thousand years prior to the [[Galactic War]]. During a [[bombing run]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] military, the section of [[Prison/Legends|prison]] in which Soa was imprisoned was discovered.

==Biography==
A massive [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Soa rose to power as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] in the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of its [[Species/Legends|species]] well before the Empire's collapse. Legends later claimed that Soa, leading an army that included his creations, the [[Annihilation Droid XRR-3]] and the alchemical monster [[Gharj]], conquered a thousand [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in his time, and he earned the title "Infernal One." Among those worlds was the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], whose [[Sith (species)/Legends|native Sith]] he ruled.<ref name="TOR:EV" /> Sometime after the Sith [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]]'s uprising against the Rakata,<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> Soa and his [[Infernal Council]] of traitorous Sith were imprisoned with their army in the [[Eternity Vault]] on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]; legends said that it took an army of Rakata and other ancient species to stop him.<ref name="TOR:EV" />

Millennia later, conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] unintentionally caused Soa to reawaken. Both sides, somewhat aware of what they had awakened, sent a strike team to eliminate Soa before he regained enough power to become a threat to the entire galaxy. It is unknown which team accomplished their task. The strike team faced Soa's creations and allies, and eventually made their way to his imprisonment chamber. When they arrived, he finally broke free from his restraints and fought them, taunting them and claiming that he could not be defeated. The strike team, however, proved him wrong and finally brought an end to the Infernal One after 20,000 years.<ref name="TOR:EV" />

{{Expandsect}}

==Personality and traits==
Soa had an ego to match his great size and power. He was arrogant and was shown to be extremely proud of his ancient accomplishments to the point where he would brag about them outright. When he faced the strike team sent to stop him he refused to even consider the possibility of defeat and instead proceeded to insult and belittle his enemies.<ref name="TOR:EV" />

==Powers and abilities==
Soa was a powerful user of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He utilized a suite of combat abilities to both protect himself from assaults and to attack opponents. These abilities included [[Force lightning/Legends|Ball Lightning]], hurling opponents into [[Mind prison|Mind Traps]], and extensive telekinetic abilities that allowed him to send opponents on lengthy airborne paths and to destabilize and manipulate large platforms. He could also summon an extremely powerful [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]] that was only overcome by dropping heavy pillars onto his frame.<ref name="TOR:EV" />

He also appears to have been gifted at [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]], claiming to have created an army of slaves and the monster [[Gharj]]. Additionally he was a skilled manipulator of Rakatan Force-based technologies, having developed the [[Annihilation Droid XRR-3]].<ref name="TOR:EV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soa appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the target of the Eternity Vault Operation. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
